description.zh: 清晰的侧栏导航、紧凑的筛选与表格。适合借鉴信息密度与页面层级。
description.en: A light workspace with a clear sidebar, compact filters and a customer table. Borrow its density and visual hierarchy.

relation.zh: 位于主内容区左侧，与内容并排。
relation.en: Place the sidebar beside the main content.

description.zh: 保留常驻侧栏与主内容并排的布局。
description.en: Keep the persistent sidebar beside the main content.

description.zh: 保留浅色背景、蓝色强调与浅蓝选中底色。
description.en: Keep the light surface, blue accent and pale blue active background.

description.zh: 保留菜单文字与分组标题的字号、字重层级。
description.en: Keep the type hierarchy of navigation entries and group labels.

description.zh: 保留导航与正文之间的细分隔线。
description.en: Keep a fine divider between navigation and content.

description.zh: 保留已展示的当前菜单选中状态；没有确认过渡动效。
description.en: Keep the visible active navigation state; no transition motion is confirmed.

relation.zh: 位于主内容区顶部、筛选区上方。
relation.en: Place the toolbar at the top of the main content, above the filters.

description.zh: 保留左侧标题、右侧主要操作的横向排列。
description.en: Keep the page title on the left and primary action on the right.

description.zh: 保留浅色背景与深色主要按钮。
description.en: Keep the light surface and dark primary button.

description.zh: 保留标题、说明与按钮的文字层级。
description.en: Keep the type hierarchy of the title, supporting text and action.

description.zh: 减少装饰，以留白分隔页面标题和正文。
description.en: Use spacing to separate the title and content with minimal decoration.

relation.zh: 位于客户列表上方，控件沿同一水平线排列。
relation.en: Place filters above the customer table, aligned in a row.

description.zh: 保留筛选控件的横向排列和一致间距。
description.en: Keep horizontally aligned filters with consistent spacing.

description.zh: 保留白色控件表面与浅灰色边界。
description.en: Keep white controls and light gray boundaries.

description.zh: 保留统一的控件文字层级。
保留轻量细边框与小圆角。
description.en: Keep fine borders and restrained corner rounding.

relation.zh: 位于筛选区下方，列与表头保持对齐。
relation.en: Place the customer table below the filters, with aligned headers and columns.

description.zh: 保留紧凑表格、对齐的列和底部分页。
description.en: Keep the compact table, aligned columns and pagination below.

description.zh: 保留浅色表头、正文表面和浅蓝选中行。
description.en: Keep the light table header, white rows and pale blue selected row.

description.zh: 保留表头、正文与辅助信息的文字层级。
description.en: Keep the type hierarchy of headers, rows and supporting details.

description.zh: 保留行分隔线和表格外部细边框。
description.en: Keep fine row dividers and a light outer border.

description.zh: 保留已展示的行选中外观，不附加未经确认的动效。
description.en: Keep the visible selected-row appearance without adding unconfirmed motion.
